Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states "22 years old." The Predicted Answer calculates the age of the United States Air Force at the time of the inactivation of the 317th Fighter-Interceptor Squadron (December 31, 1969), referencing its establishment date (September 18, 1947) and concludes that it was "about 22 years old—rounded to the nearest year." This matches both the calculation process and the final answer of 22 years, as required by the Ground Truth Answer.

Decision: TRUE
